title: Zesty Crunchy Jamaican Coconut Toast
description: A lazy Sunday Jamaican dish featuring crusty bread and coconut cream, perfect for a relaxing morning. This vegetarian-friendly recipe is easy to make and delicious to eat.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Slice the crusty bread into 1-inch thick slices and place on a baking sheet.
Spread a layer of coconut cream on each bread slice.
Sprinkle shredded coconut and jamaican jerk seasoning over the coconut cream.
Drizzle lime juice and sprinkle salt over the top of each slice.
Dot the top of each slice with unsalted butter.
Bake the bread slices in the preheated oven for 10 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Remove the bread from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
